content.short: Hiro Platform provides developer tools to build on Stacks, a Bitcoin L2.
content.description: Hiro Platform provides a streamlined workspace for developers to build and deploy applications on Stacks, a Bitcoin layer-2 network. It supports starting new projects or importing existing GitHub repositories, writing Clarity smart contracts in a ready-to-use environment, and deploying those contracts to testnet or mainnet directly from your web browser. By simplifying setup and offering an integrated end-to-end workflow, Hiro helps teams launch robust blockchain apps on Stacks more quickly and with less friction.
content.meta: Hiro Platform enables building apps on Stacks, a Bitcoin L2, via a hosted dev environment. Discover Hiro Platform and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
